t.zh: 两句话长得几乎一样，with 短语却挂在不同的词上。
t.en: Two sentences that look almost the same, with the with phrase hanging on different words.

title.zh: We compare our model with the baseline.
title.en: We compare our model with the baseline.

body.zh: 同一个 with：models with different depths 是“深度不同的模型”，挂名词；compare our model with the baseline 是“拿我们的模型和基线比”，挂动词。动词自己要什么（compare … with …），常常决定了介词短语挂在哪。
body.en: The same with: models with different depths are models that differ in depth, on the noun; compare our model with the baseline sets the model against the baseline, on the verb. What a verb asks for (compare … with …) often decides where a phrase hangs.

note.zh: 形状一样，挂法不一样：看动词要什么，再看意思。
note.en: Same shape, different hanging: see what the verb asks for, then the meaning.

brief.zh: 标出主干，把 with 短语挂到它修饰的词上。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton and hang the with phrase on the word it modifies.

hint.en: What is it that has different depths?

tasks.sentence: We compare models with different depths.

compare.zh: 挂在 compare 上，就成了“拿不同的深度去和模型比较”。这里比较的是几个深度不同的模型。
compare.en: Hung on compare, it means comparing models against different depths. What is compared here is models that differ in depth.

after.zh: with different depths 挂在 models 上：比较的是深度不同的几个模型。
after.en: with different depths hangs on models: the models compared differ in depth.

brief.zh: 标出主干，把 with 短语挂到它修饰的词上。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton and hang the with phrase on the word it modifies.

hint.zh: compare A with B 里，B 是什么？
hint.en: In compare A with B, what is B?

tasks.sentence: We compare our model with the baseline.

model.zh: 挂在 model 上，就成了“带着基线的那个模型”。compare A with B 是拿 A 和 B 比。
model.en: Hung on model, it means our model that has a baseline with it. compare A with B sets A against B.
